welcome_sequence.subject: Welcome to GLP Clinic Scout
welcome_sequence.body_text:
Hi,

Thanks for signing up for our comparison guides and updates.

Start here: https://glpclinicscout.com/providers/

Before paying a provider, confirm the total price, what is included, cancellation terms and how to contact support. Reported information can change, so check current terms with the provider.

We are an independent comparison publisher, not a clinic. Our guides are educational, not medical advice. We may earn a commission when you use some links. Paid sponsorship never changes our independent rankings.

welcome_sequence.subject: Four questions to ask before you pay
welcome_sequence.body_text:
Hi,

Ask the provider:

What is the total cost, including required visits, labs and medication?
What happens if I am not eligible or do not receive a prescription?
How do cancellations, refunds and renewals work?
How can I reach support, and what response time do you report?

Use the answers to compare current terms. Only a licensed clinician can advise on treatment or prescribe medication.

Compare providers: https://glpclinicscout.com/providers/
